title: faqs.me — Beautiful FAQ sections. Free forever.
excerpt: Pick a template, make it yours, copy the code. One self-contained FAQ snippet for any website — no scripts phoning home, no watermark, no account.
content_html:
Free forever · No signup

A beautiful FAQ section for your website in 2 minutes.

Pick a template, make it yours, copy the code. One self-contained snippet — no scripts phoning home, no watermark, no strings.

Already have a website? Let AI draft your FAQs.

Free while in beta — no signup needed

No account. Copy code without signing up.

No watermark. The code is yours, forever.

No catch. Standalone HTML — nothing phones home.

For AI agents

Your agent can build and install the section for you.

Connect the public faqs.me MCP server to choose a template, generate ready-to-use code, and get an editable handoff link — without storing your project on our servers.

MCP for agents

Three steps. Two minutes.

1 · Pick a template

Live, animated previews — accordions, cards, chat bubbles, searchable lists. Try them right in the gallery.

2 · Make it yours

Type your Q&As — or let AI draft them from your site. Match your brand colors, fonts, and corner radius.

3 · Copy the code

One self-contained snippet with SEO structured data built in. Paste it into any site — WordPress to Webflow.
